reviews.comment:
Muy buen lugar. Hermoso el camping y las cabañas, a poquitas cuadras del centro, al pie de un cerro y atravesado por un arroyo hermoso. Realmente paradisíaco el lugar, muy amable el personal del ACA, parte de la estación está en plena remodelación para mejorar la atención de los socios cómo suele ser

(Translated by Google)
A very nice place. The campsite and cabins are beautiful, just a few blocks from the center, at the foot of a hill and crossed by a lovely stream. The place is truly idyllic, the ACA staff are very friendly, and part of the station is currently being renovated to improve service for members, as is their custom.
